process.name: Understand
process.description: Clarify the business goal, users, requirements, constraints, and success criteria.
process.what_happens: We talk through the problem, who it affects, what is already in place, and the constraints around the work.
process.client_can_expect: A shared understanding of the goal, open questions, and the information still needed to shape the work.
process.purpose: Make sure the work starts with the problem to solve rather than an assumed solution.

process.name: Plan
process.description: Define the scope, architecture, milestones, and deliverables.
process.what_happens: We turn the agreed goal into a practical scope, outline the technical approach, and identify dependencies and deliverables.
process.client_can_expect: A clear view of what is included, the decisions to make, and how the work will be organized.
process.purpose: Create a useful boundary for the project before implementation begins.

process.name: Build
process.description: Develop the interface, backend, integrations, and tests.
process.what_happens: The agreed product is implemented across its interface, backend, integrations, and relevant tests.
process.client_can_expect: Progress that can be reviewed against the agreed scope, with questions and decisions surfaced as they arise.
process.purpose: Turn the plan into working software while keeping the product goal in view.

process.name: Launch
process.description: Handle deployment, production configuration, QA, and handoff.
process.what_happens: The software is prepared for its intended environment through deployment, production configuration, quality checks, and handoff.
process.client_can_expect: A review of the launch-ready work and the relevant handoff information for the project.
process.purpose: Make the completed scope usable in its intended setting.

process.name: Improve
process.description: Continue with optional maintenance, analytics, iteration, and new features.
process.what_happens: If useful, follow-on work can address maintenance, analytics, iteration, or additional features.
process.client_can_expect: A conversation about what is working, what needs attention, and whether another piece of work makes sense.
process.purpose: Leave room for the product to evolve as needs and feedback become clearer.

process_journey.summary: Start with an inquiry through Book a Session. We use the first conversation to understand the project; if the work is a fit, we define its scope before building. Launch may be followed by optional improvement work.

booking_journey.summary: Share the project context that you have. A first conversation can clarify the goals and requirements, then define a practical scope before you decide whether to move forward.
